title: Show Buyers Floor Plans in 3D
summary: Turn flat floor plans into 3D models and preview images clients can turn and understand, and check plan sets for likely issues before review.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already sell from plans; the value is drafting time saved and clearer client decisions.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Clients understand a layout faster and ask fewer questions.
Less drafting time spent on early previews.
who_its_for: Home builders who sell from plans.

stack.name: Plan to 3D
stack.role: Turns a 2D drawing into a 3D model with a preview image and rough quantities.
stack.creator: krish1403

stack.name: Plan Precheck Bot
stack.role: Checks a plan set for likely issues and prepares markups for a licensed reviewer.

steps.name: You
steps.does: Check and share with the client

outputs: A plan set checked for likely issues

steps: Make the 3D model and preview image.
Compare it with the real drawing.
Share the preview with the client and precheck the plan set before review.
guardrails: Label every model as a preview, not a construction document.
Use quantities only as a starting point.
